review_text: Bought this powerbank 3 months ago. It worked fine initially, but now it starts overheating excessively while charging my phone.
Extremely disappointed with warranty. When I reached out to customer support, they gave excuses claiming internal damage not in policy.
Great battery capacity! Held charge for 4 full charges on my trip.
Powerbank gets burning hot after 20 minutes of fast charging. Feels like a safety hazard.
Warranty request rejected. Company claimed liquid damage internally even though I never exposed it to water.
